title: Sierra Leone - Enhancing the capability of digital public infrastructure to optimize service delivery by improving interoperability of core government systems: Terms of Reference for Consultancy Services to Design and install a Government Service Bus (GSB) prototype
why_not: Fetched and read, then excluded because it falls outside the 2025-09-01 to 2026-09-03 window - the terms of reference anticipate a contract signed in June or July 2025 and closing by 31 December 2025 - and because the government service bus is already represented in the queue by the September 2025 AG4BSD aide-memoire; it names CRVS among the systems whose interoperability requirements are to be assessed, so it is registered here for any later widening of the cap.
